meta.why_this_can_mislead: Name matching is fuzzy and deliberately generous, so both lists below contain false positives by design. An entry appearing as unlogged may already be in the tracker under a different transliteration. An entry appearing as absent is most often designated under a non-cyber OFAC programme such as RUSSIA-EO14024, or spelled differently enough that matching failed. Only entries claiming a US designation are checked, so UK, EU and Australia-only sanctions are correctly left out. Delisting is the least likely explanation, not the first. Nothing here is a finding; every line is a question for a person.
meta.distortion: High on individual lines, low on the direction of travel.
